additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401187 - DC/Si-D/FI - [MP / P9 170001029] - large amount of zero sessions CRM:00641000968
additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari Harjunpaa,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue of a large number of zero sessions on Outlet 2, we have analyzed the logs and observed the following:
Charging sessions have not started due to the error:
code: 54, msg: "ERR_EVCOM, EV communication problem detected."
This error was specifically associated with Outlet 2 during our initial analysis.
We reviewed the logs on SCB but could not identify additional details or the root cause for the failed session reported on 19th September 2025.
Additionally, EcoG logs were accessed via SSH for detailed analysis; however, no logs were available for the reported date.
On a positive note, we observed that several charging sessions for Outlet 2 (DC2) were successfully completed on 21st September.
At this stage, we will continue monitoring the case over the next few days. Should the issue reoccur, we will promptly capture the EcoG logs for further investigation
.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
